offline.title: No connection to the runtime.
offline.body: The Studio only ever talks to the runtime — without it there are no building blocks, no behaviors and no duck. This page reconnects by itself as soon as it is running.
offline.skills: Building blocks appear as soon as the runtime is running.

draft.title: Draft with AI
draft.lead: Describe in a sentence what the duck should do. An AI model drafts a behavior from it; you check it in the editor before anything is saved or started. No picture is sent, only your sentence.
draft.placeholder: e.g. When I say “Hello”, find me, walk to me and quack twice.
draft.nokey: This needs a key for an AI vendor.
draft.notice: Draft by {vendor}. Read every step and change what is wrong — nothing is saved until you press Save.
draft.error.no_key: There is no key for this vendor.
draft.error.invalid: The model did not produce a valid behavior twice. Describe it more simply, or try another vendor.
draft.error.unreachable: The vendor cannot be reached right now.
draft.error.vendor: The vendor answered with an error. Is the key still valid, and the quota not used up?
draft.error.empty: The vendor did not answer anything.
draft.error.too_long: That is too long; a sentence or two is enough.
draft.error.empty_description: First write what the duck should do.

ai.title: AI vendors
ai.lead: The duck can find people right on this computer, with no key and without a picture leaving it. For questions about the camera picture — “Where is the red ball?” — it can also ask an AI model; for that you need a key (API key) from a vendor. Without a key, a simple detector on this computer answers in its place.
ai.privacy.keys: Your key is checked with the vendor and then stays on this computer, in a file only you can read. The Studio never shows it again, only its last characters.
ai.privacy.frames: Pictures only go to a vendor when a behavior names it explicitly. The Studio then says so in red: “Picture is sent to …”.

ai.error.model: The key works, but this model is not enabled for it. Pick another model.
ai.error.unreachable: The vendor cannot be reached right now. The key was not saved; try again in a moment.
ai.error.format: That does not look like a key. Copy it without spaces.
ai.error.unknown_model: The Studio does not know this model.
ai.error.failed: That did not work. The key was not saved.
ai.rate: The duck asks at most {hz} times a second and at most {calls} times per run.
ai.offline: The runtime cannot be reached, so no vendor can be set up right now.
ai.local.title: Person detection on this computer
ai.local.note: Finds people in the camera picture about ten times a second, fast enough for following. No key, no cost. Model: {name} ({license}), downloaded once.
ai.local.auto: Automatic: on the real duck. The simulation keeps its marker, the practice duck its drawn person.
ai.local.people: Always, in the simulation and the practice duck too — to try it out; it will mostly find nobody there.
ai.local.error: Loading did not work (no connection, or the file did not match). Nothing was saved.
